content.text: In the installed agents 0.27.0, an Agent gets its identity (`this.name`) from the Durable Object's `ctx.id.name`. An ID created with `idFromString()` (or `newUniqueId()`) doesn't carry a name, so `ctx.id.name` is missing. When the RPC call reaches the Agent, it can't work out its name and throws an error in `node_modules/agents/dist/lifecycle-CFu6OV03.js:1097`. The message says it "could not determine its Durable Object name. Address it with idFromName() or getByName()". Names over 1,024 bytes fail the same way. The fix is to address the Agent by name with `getAgentByName(env.MyAgent, name)`, `env.MyAgent.getByName(name)`, or `env.MyAgent.get(env.MyAgent.idFromName(name))`. If it still fails locally after that, update Wrangler/workerd and use a current `compatibility_date`.
